title: Rectangular box base
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector of [0.5408, 0.0, 0.0]. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.2092, 0.0), then from (0.2092, 0.0) to (0.2092, 0.4454), followed by (0.2092, 0.4454) to (0.0, 0.4454), and finally back to the origin. For the second loop, draw a line from (0.0077, 0.0118) to (0.2015, 0.0118), then from (0.2015, 0.0118) to (0.2015, 0.4336), followed by (0.2015, 0.4336) to (0.0077, 0.4336), and finally back to (0.0077, 0.0118). Apply a scale factor of 0.4454 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the sketch using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the vector [0.5408, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch 0.102 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body from this extrusion. The final dimensions of the rectangular box base are 0.2092 meters in length, 0.4454 meters in width, and 0.102 meters in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane()

# Outer rectangle
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0, 0.0).lineTo(0.2092, 0.0).lineTo(0.2092, 0.4454).lineTo(0.0, 0.4454).close()

# Inner rectangle (cutout)
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0077, 0.0118).lineTo(0.2015, 0.0118).lineTo(0.2015, 0.4336).lineTo(0.0077, 0.4336).close()

# Extrude the sketch
box = sketch.extrude(0.102)

# Apply the translation
r = box.translate((0.5408, 0.0, 0.0))

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Outer dimensions
X = 0.2092
Y = 0.4454
Z = 0.1020

# Wall thickness
t = 0.008

# Create outer box
outer = cq.Workplane("XY").box(X, Y, Z, centered=(True, True, False))

# Create inner cavity (open top pocket leaving a bottom)
inner = cq.Workplane("XY").box(X - 2 * t, Y - 2 * t, Z, centered=(True, True, False)) \
    .translate((0, 0, t))

# Cut cavity from outer box
r = outer.cut(inner)
